purpose: Infor CloudSuite Industrial documentation promotion and reusable capped bookmark projection-chain authority.

patch.auth: OAuth 2.0 bearer token through Infor ION API Gateway or a directly issued Mongoose security token for an approved private endpoint

connectionRoutes.type: Infor OS cloud ION API route
connectionRoutes.authentication: dedicated backend-service OAuth 2.0 client credentials with enforced app scopes and a constrained Infor user/role where required
connectionRoutes.notes: Pin the regional gateway host, Infor tenant, Mongoose configuration, site, REST version, exact IDO LoadCollection route, property projection, filter/order, effective record cap and schema. X-Infor-MongooseConfig is part of source authority.

connectionRoutes.type: direct or on-premises Mongoose REST route
connectionRoutes.authentication: customer-managed Mongoose security token over an exact private HTTPS origin
connectionRoutes.notes: Use the customer-controlled edge route. No public ingress, direct database access, token evidence, UpdateCollection or Invoke authority is granted.

connectionRoutes.type: Infor ION BOD, governed export or middleware fallback
connectionRoutes.authentication: customer-owned ION, secure-file or managed integration identity
connectionRoutes.notes: Use existing managed-export and batch-reconciliation controls with exact document type, accounting entity/site, schema, checksums, row totals and replay identifiers.

Infor-OS-cloud.routing: Regional Infor OS API Gateway to one authorised tenant, Mongoose configuration and site per checkpoint namespace.

direct-or-on-premises-Mongoose.routing: Customer-controlled outbound edge connection to one exact HTTPS Mongoose origin/configuration; direct SQL remains denied.

multi-site-or-acquired-estate.routing: Partition every tenant, configuration, site and acquired instance independently even when Infor OS provides one shared access layer.

idoReadAuthority.notes: Allow only reviewed LoadCollection projections. Infor documents separate UpdateCollection and Invoke surfaces, so successful OAuth or Mongoose authentication never implies safe read authority.

cappedProjectionChainAuthority.receiptPolicy: Bind every page to one WFM tenant, connection, Infor tenant, Mongoose configuration, site, exact HTTPS origin/version, IDO collection, property/filter/order query, schema, scope and effective record cap. Follow MoreRowsExist and byte-exact bookmark continuity to a terminal false value; row count alone never proves completeness. Hash but do not retain raw bookmarks, collapse only exact stable-ID + source-version + payload-digest replays and quarantine conflicts. Emit reconciliation evidence only.

patch.stableIds: Preserve tenant + configuration + site + IDO collection + source stable ID and source version. Keep job/operation, employee, work-centre, item, lot, PO/vendor and ledger keys as typed local references; never join identical codes across sites or acquired configurations without explicit mapping.
patch.freshness: Use bounded polling with provider bookmarks and MoreRowsExist. Optional ION/BOD signals may lower latency but remain hints until reconciled against the authoritative scoped read or complete governed export.
patch.permissions: A dedicated integration principal needs only IDO-level and property-level read permission plus required licensing. Deny UpdateCollection, InvokeIDOMethod, upload/download control surfaces, configuration discovery beyond bootstrap, token administration, reports with side effects and all database writes.
patch.paginationDelta: REST v2 LoadCollection returns MoreRowsExist and bookmark-based continuation. Effective record caps are administrator/farm/user dependent and can differ from the typical 200; discover and pin the effective cap, continue until MoreRowsExist=false, and quarantine bookmark/query/schema/cap drift. Delta fields are IDO- and customer-specific and must be schema-discovered; otherwise use bounded overlapping windows or governed snapshots.
patch.customFields: Discover approved standard and customer-extended IDO properties per configuration. Exact property allowlists and schema fingerprints prevent wildcard expansion, renamed fields or custom-load-method drift from silently changing WFM semantics.
patch.regionalApiVersions: Pin the customer-specific regional Infor OS gateway host, tenant identifier, Mongoose configuration, CSI/Mongoose release and REST version. Cloud, single-tenant and on-premises routes do not share checkpoints or fail over across regions automatically.
patch.rateLimits: No universal CSI read rate is assumed. Infor API Gateway can apply tenant-specific smoothing, quotas and spike arrest with HTTP 429; use bounded concurrency, respect observed policy/reset evidence and never widen scope or switch hosts after throttling.
failureModes: wrong Infor tenant or Mongoose configuration
MoreRowsExist true without a usable bookmark
bookmark gap, loop or cross-query replay
custom load method does not support bookmarking
patch.reconciliation: Require exact tenant/configuration/site/projection/query/schema/scope/cap identity on every page, trusted checkpoint predecessor and trusted observation horizon, MessageCode success, gapless bookmark succession and a terminal MoreRowsExist=false. Row count never proves completeness. Collapse exact stable-ID + source-version + payload-digest replays, quarantine conflicts, hash raw bookmarks out of evidence and keep missing rows non-deleting. Re-read bounded windows after auth refresh, 429, outage, schema drift or BOD hint.
patch.schemaDrift: Fingerprint REST version, IDO name, explicit property list, property types/labels, custom properties, stable key, filter/order contract, effective cap and bookmark behavior per configuration and site. Any drift quarantines the dataset before checkpoint consideration.
patch.retriesReconnect: 401 stops for credential/tenant review; 403 stops for IDO/property licensing or permission review; 429 uses bounded backoff under the same host/tenant/configuration/query. Network/5xx recovery restarts from the last committed predecessor with the approved overlap or complete bookmark chain; never resume a bookmark under a changed query/schema/cap.
patch.evidenceNote: Documentation-only verification. Official Infor documentation establishes ION OAuth 2.0 client credentials, Mongoose security-token alternatives, configuration headers, IDO/property permissions, LoadCollection/UpdateCollection/Invoke separation, administrator-dependent record caps, MoreRowsExist and bookmark continuation. No sandbox, no customer tenant authentication, no live read, no real pagination, no denied mutation and no hosted proof are claimed.
valueOpportunities: combine open jobs, operation demand, work-centre constraints and WFM skills/availability to target only genuine qualified-labour shortages and reduce avoidable overtime or agency use
separate paid idle time caused by material, machine, queue, quality or supplier constraints from labour-capacity shortages
compare job labour transactions, WFM attendance and payroll-ready time to find missing, duplicated, backflushed or misattributed hours without treating ERP labour as attendance truth
attribute labour and rework cost to job, operation, item, scrap and good-unit outcomes while preserving source authority and causal uncertainty
reuse one governed IDO projection pattern across small single-site SyteLine customers and global multi-configuration Infor estates
patch.causalOutcomeReadiness: Preserve job, operation, employee/team, work-centre, material, quality, scrap, cost and source-version identifiers with effective/observation times. Record recommendation, approval, intervention and outcome windows separately; distinguish direct labour, indirect labour, backflushed labour and machine time, and never claim a labour action caused throughput or cost movement without controlling competing material, machine, quality and demand changes.
patch.nextBuildAction: Use an authorised Infor CSI test tenant to prove backend-service OAuth, exact regional tenant/configuration/site binding, reviewed IDO and property discovery, LoadCollection bookmark recovery across an effective cap, custom property drift, 401/403/429/outage recovery, and denied UpdateCollection and InvokeIDOMethod calls without production or payroll mutation.
